file_to_url: strip output_dir prefix, strip trailing index.html, prepend leading slash; root index.html -> /
second_source_of_truth: sitemap.xml emitted by Hugo's default sitemap template (counts URLs, verified 1:1 against HTML page files)
discrepancy_fixed: Build log reported 'Pages | 19' vs rule count 11: the log counts the 7 RSS index.xml files and sitemap.xml as pages, so it overcounts routes by 8. Switched the second source of truth to sitemap.xml, which matched the rule exactly (11 = 11).
gotchas: Taxonomy list and term pages (tags/, categories/, tags/hugo/, categories/news/) are real rendered pages present in both output and sitemap; a hand count of content .md files (7: home, about, posts section, 2 posts, docs section, guide) undercounts the true 11 routes.
The build log 'Pages' statistic counts RSS index.xml feeds and sitemap.xml as pages (19 vs 11 actual routes) and must not be used as a route count.
404.html is emitted as a top-level 404.html (not 404/index.html) and is excluded from Hugo's default sitemap, so it needs an explicit exclusion even under the **/index.html rule.
With pretty URLs (default) every page is <path>/index.html; if uglyURLs were enabled pages would be **/*.html and the pattern would change.
